scope: Independent review of peer composition and bounded evidence. Profile is authored here and closure/self-validated; peer independent profile review is separate. CPU only.

checks.origins: Canonical integration modules checked before attach; loaded codec packages checked against pinned inventory.
checks.attachment: Exact NativeFront/NativeCheckpointStore, fixed argv matching Popen args, zero requests/controls, no pending reply, ready geometry/one load, empty private root.
checks.held_fds: Rehash held executable and check current binary inode before claim; held root FD dev/ino equals current root. Both regression refusals passed before RUN.
checks.timers: Trusted explicit monotonic launch/activity; no readiness reset. Every RUN and disposition guarded; soft close allows admitted disposition.
checks.errors: Store snapshot/delete guard inside active service thread. Preserve original error; no recovery RELEASE/retry/close after ambiguity. One normal close validates terminal counts.
checks.receipt: Short state lock refuses active serving/closing snapshots; repeated serve refusal preserves terminal proof.
checks.evidence: Exclusive0600 files under owned0700 held root; byte/file-count bounds, inode/content refusal, partial-write charges and poisoned-on-error state preserve evidence.
checks.closure: Actual p199 audit, historical source/ELF/dependencies, new profile/composition/evidence/lifecycle modules and tests, transitive fixture and independent storage receipt are bound.
checks.storage: 160MiB source-derived success logs; remaining96MiB auxiliary forecast not proven. Whole768MiB forecast unadmitted.

resolved_findings: Check held binary identity before first RUN
Compare held root FD to admitted directory
limitations: No native process or real-model serving run in this new component proof.
Public attach tests mock profile validation and use nonexecuted synthetic ELF/front state; profile tests separately verify actual historical identity.
Whole-host reservation, faults/memory/drain guards and one incident action belong to outer coordinator.
External native/driver/filesystem growth prevents certified whole-window storage bound.
Launch-origin idle includes model loading. Arbitrary prompts have no prerecorded oracle.
Fresh paths require an existing trusted local parent; direct group-writable repository parent is refused.
